name: artefacts67
description: Publishing private-by-default self-contained HTML artefacts, with deliberate visitor sharing and optional password gates — a Cloudflare Worker with D1, R2 and one Durable Object.

scripts.build: npm --prefix worker run sync-contract && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix worker run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.migrate: npm --prefix worker exec -- wrangler -c worker/wrangler.jsonc d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.migrate:local: npm --prefix worker exec -- wrangler -c worker/wrangler.jsonc d1 migrations apply DB --local
